evidence_note: Store reviews are self-selected and skew to people who are delighted or angry. This is a small corpus: every written review in twelve months, under 350 in all and under 100 from iPhone, and none carries the reviewer's age. Treat every card as a signal to check against Giant Eagle's own app and myPerks data, not as a validated problem or a measure of Gen Z.

Specific Complaint: Most complaints are about the app failing at basic steps: signing in, paying, staying open, the shopping list, the scanner.
Many say a specific update broke something that used to work.
Several reviewers say they finished the order on the website or went to another store instead.
Specific Praise: Praise is mostly for people, not the app: curbside staff, shoppers who fill orders, named associates.
The rest is about time and access: busy schedules, limited mobility, no car.
Feature Request: Few requests, and most ask to bring back something an update removed (coupon filters, expiry dates) or to show the loyalty card faster (Wallet, widget).
Generic Good: Short approval with nothing specific. It lifts the star average and says nothing about why.

category_notes.Login & Sign-in: The largest complaint area. Forced sign-outs, passkey prompts, reset codes that fail, and being asked to sign in again at the register.
category_notes.Checkout & Payment: Payment that won't load or process, carts that crash at checkout, a December 2025 update that blocked checkout, and benefit cards (SNAP, EBT, Propel, UPMC Healthy Card) not accepted. The most-liked review in the set is here.
category_notes.Crashes & Speed: Crashes, lag, and fixes by reinstall. Two clusters stand out: an early-November 2025 update after which the app wouldn't load or find stores, and a January 2026 build that crashed on open until a fix days later.
category_notes.Shopping List & Favorites: A June list redesign that reviewers say broke the list, plus removed 'previously purchased' and hidden favorites.
category_notes.Barcode Scanner: The camera scanner stopped working after a late-July update, including the in-store price check.
category_notes.Search & Product Info: Search that misses items, products sold in store but not online, and no aisle locations.
category_notes.Design & Navigation: Confusing checkout and navigation. One reviewer says it's hard for older users.
category_notes.Privacy & Permissions: Location prompts on every launch, birth date to link a card, cookie toggles that don't work, a required lock screen.
category_notes.Coupons & Deals: Split. Praised for savings and highlighted deals; criticized for removed coupon filters and expiry dates, promo codes that fail, and sale prices not applied.
category_notes.myPerks & Loyalty Card: Points are liked; getting to the card is not. Wallet and widget don't show it, and perks sometimes don't apply at self-checkout.
category_notes.Prices & Selection: Several say prices run higher than nearby grocers; others praise quality and stock.
category_notes.Curbside Pickup: Mostly praise for curbside staff. The complaints are the app spinning or freezing at pickup check-in.
category_notes.Delivery: Fees, bag charges, tips that can't be edited, missing items, and crushed bags; also praise for on-time drivers.
category_notes.Order Changes & Time Slots: Adding items to a placed order can lose the time slot or restart checkout.
category_notes.Order Quality: Missing or poor-quality items, and one accuracy compliment.
category_notes.Support & Refunds: No reply to messages, no refund option in the app, no way to contact the developers.
category_notes.Pharmacy: Prescription refill setup that won't load, a second sign-in for the pharmacy section, and a separate pharmacy app. Pharmacy staff get praise.
category_notes.Staff & Service: Almost all praise, often naming the associate.
category_notes.Saves Time & Effort: Mostly praise. Busy workers and families, a student before term, people with limited mobility, disabilities, or no car.
category_notes.Recipes & Meal Ideas: Rare. One reviewer wants to save recipes and add all the ingredients to the cart.

all.title: People get signed out and can't get back in
